launches.title: Result - where businesses get built
launches.tagline: A platform for entrepreneurs to start and operate their businesses.
launches.body:
**_TLDR:_** Result is a platform for entrepreneurs to start and operate businesses end-to-end. We take users from an idea to building the product, accepting payments, incorporation, and marketing. Our 8 private beta users collectively do $2.8M ARR.

Hi YC, [Aaryan Kushwah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aaryan-kushwah) and [Savio Martin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saviomartin/) made their first money on the internet starting businesses + side projects, and today **more people _than ever_** are starting businesses.

We will be where solopreneurs, indiehackers, creative founders, and content creators make _their first internet dollar. **Result is the operating system to start the next generation of businesses.**_

**Let's make our first internet dollar in this post**.

1\. **Build** - you start using Result _with or without_ a product, let's assume we don’t have one right now

In this example, we’re building [1600.lol](http://1600.lol) → an SAT learning tool with real past paper questions.

Result can build apps **with payment gateways**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/fd663606-9301-47ba-8ae8-143ab3786036)

We have our **_own_** payment gateway provider with **custom endpoints** to give each user their own payment gateway, keep record of payments, and we’re also working with them to provide **_tax filing capabilities_**.

If you already have a product built you can connect your existing Github repo and Result will have context, or if you’re a business that doesn’t need a product (service, consulting, etc.) you don’t need to connect anything!

2\. Simultaneously, it’s going to lock in a **brand** for the business.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/8dc92a8c-cd3a-4d8b-9b96-4cbd1d4005fc)

3\. **Sell -** Let’s start selling. First, Result helps you rank better on SEO and then creates content for you to post: reels, blogs, posts and whatever works specifically for your niche.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/0599fbb0-525e-4cb4-9932-023f728806ad)

This is a fan favorite feature, **_Tinder for marketing posts_**:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/bfd69287-1887-4b9e-9f99-4cdd51faf28a)

4\. **Incorporate** - At this point, once we’re confident the product is doing well → let’s make this a real business. **_You can incorporate on the platform_**. We have a relationship with a registered agent for a whitelabelled service. We’re working extremely hard on this and will be able to incorporate companies **_directly from chat, through an agent, or even through Claude Code._**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/ca4b1fa5-4a5f-4cec-8ebb-03b139bbdf6f)

5\. **Analyze** - our biggest advantage of owning the entire flow is **_attribution, cross-data analytics_** and actually driving **_meaningful revenue-boosting insights_**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/02885b15-1a2f-4490-a6cf-f3d3c06cd262)

We’re working on some really cool architecture for attribution, our goal is to be able to generate insights like:

1. This specific format of a social media post drew 10x more views but it targeted the wrong ICP so it converted only 10%, whereas this post that didn’t draw as many views converted better because it was a better target.
2. The comments on this post resonate with customer support emails requesting this feature and it should be built instead of what the codebase has in place of it.\
   \
   **_Context_** - Where does all this information go? Company Brain!

Starting a company on a single platform from scratch gives us a unique place to retain context of the entire business from Day 1. A lot of companies are trying to build company brains for existing businesses, we decided that starting on Day 1 for a new business is the new meta.

As you operate the business on the platform, the platform learns about your business and continues to become better.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102824&key=user_uploads/1610709/d2adb3d2-53aa-4215-8779-25bfcd5db9f1)

This is how [1600.lol](http://1600.lol) is operated on Result. [1600.lol](http://1600.lol) now does $1200 MRR and is operated from Result. **_You can see how it performs at [lab.result.dev](http://lab.result.dev)_**.

We’re in private beta and **our first 8 users collectively do $2.8M ARR.**

**_Asks:_**

* If you've built side projects, small businesses before, we'd love to get in touch and show you around!
* If you know thought leaders or friends in the space (solopreneurship, indiehacking, etc.) we'd love to talk to them to learn more about what they need.
* If you have experience live-streaming, know teams behind subathons, long-duration live streaming etc, we'd love to learn more for a challenge we're starting in July!
